## IV.4 與非限定子句的關係

I decided to leave 的離開者通常是 I;I told Leo to leave 的離開者通常是 Leo。I saw Leo cross the road / crossing the road 會改變觀看事件的角度。這些差別由動詞配搭和句子意思一起決定。

## IV.5 與內容子句的關係

I know the answer. / I know that she is ready. / I know what she needs. 動詞後面的部分可以是名詞短語、that 子句或間接問題。文法書未必把三者都用同一個名稱,但學生必須知道它們的字序和意思不同。

## IV.6 與介詞短語的關係

She put the box on the table 中 on the table 幾乎不能隨意省掉,因為 put 在放置的意思下通常需要位置。She read a book on the train 的 on the train 則是額外地點消息。都用了介詞,工作卻不同。

## IV.7 量詞、代字、焦點與語氣

I gave only Ben a ticket 較明確限制「誰收到」;I only gave Ben a ticket 的重點更依賴語氣。She hurt herself 的 herself 指回主語;這類反身句也不能機械轉成被動。

# PART V — Contrastive Grammar｜相近句型比較

| 對比 | 第一種寫法 | 第二種寫法 | 重點 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 不及物/及物 | The glass broke. | Leo broke the glass. | 前句只說玻璃碎;後句說明 Leo 弄碎。 |
| 一受詞/介詞短語 | She reached the station. | She arrived at the station. | reach 直接接地點;arrive 一般用 at。 |
| 雙受詞/to 短語 | He sent May a card. | He sent a card to May. | May 在前句是間接受詞;後句在 to 後。 |
| to/for | She wrote a letter to Mum. | She wrote a letter for Mum. | to 偏向收件人;for 可表示代寫或為她而寫。 |
| 兩受詞/受詞描述 | They made Amy a cake. | They made Amy happy. | cake 是物件;happy 描述 Amy。 |
| 連繫/及物 | The soup smells nice. | I smelled the soup. | nice 描述湯;後句 soup 是受詞。 |
| make/allow | They made us wait. | They allowed us to wait. | make 主動不用 to;allow 用 to,意思不同。 |
| stop doing/stop to do | She stopped reading. | She stopped to read. | 前句停止閱讀;後句停下別的事去閱讀。 |
| 普通被動/middle | The book was read quickly. | The book reads easily. | 前句說實際被讀;後句說容易閱讀這個特性。 |
| 內容子句/名詞受詞 | I know the truth. | I know that it is true. | 第一句接名詞短語;第二句接完整內容句。 |


# PART VI — Rare, Exceptional & Context-dependent Uses｜少見、特殊或要看情境的寫法

某些表面違反普通規則的句子有特別背景,不要一見到就當作錯誤。

同源受詞

He dreamed a strange dream.

dream 可以接和夢有關的名詞,屬特殊用法。

結果句型

She danced her shoes to pieces.

跳舞令鞋子破爛,是有表達力的進階句式。

way 句型

She pushed her way through the crowd.

整組字表示透過推擠向前。

middle 句型

This jacket washes well.

這句說外套容易清洗,並非外套自己洗。

專業語域

The team progressed the project.

有些行業會把 progress 當及物動詞;一般寫作可選 advanced the project。

量度短語

The walk took two hours.

two hours 是時間量度,分類可因文法分析不同。

反身受詞

She blamed herself.

herself 指回主語,不能照普通不同人物句硬轉被動。

省略的受詞

Have you eaten?

不說吃甚麼,在日常語境仍自然。

介詞被動

The bed has been slept in.

結構上可以;情境較特別,要注意自然度。

角色位置

There seems to be a problem.

there 不是有意做事的主語;句子用來說有問題。

# PART VII — Common Errors & Misconceptions｜常見錯誤與誤解

| 不合指定一般語境的寫法 | 自然寫法 | 原因/界線 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| We discussed about the plan. | We discussed the plan. | discuss 直接接計劃;talk 才常用 about。 |
| She arrived the library. | She arrived at the library. | arrive 一般用 at / in 指地點。 |
| He explained me the answer. | He explained the answer to me. | explain 後的聽者通常用 to。 |
| She suggested me a route. | She suggested a route to me. | suggest 不是普通兩受詞動詞。 |
| They made him to wait. | They made him wait. | 使役 make 的主動句常用不帶 to 的動詞。 |
| We were made wait. | We were made to wait. | 使役 make 的被動要有 to。 |
| He turned off it. | He turned it off. | 可分開助詞遇上 it,要把 it 放中間。 |
| She looks happily.(形容她外表) | She looks happy. | look 連繫動詞後用形容詞說明人。 |
| Who did break the glass?(中性問主語) | Who broke the glass? | 中性主語 who 問句一般不用 did;加 did 可有強調意思。 |
| The parcel was arrived. | The parcel arrived. | arrive 一般不形成這種被動。 |


**留意:**表內有些寫法在特定語氣、地區或另一個意思下可以出現。這裏教的是表列情境中較自然、較適合模仿的寫法。

# PART VIII — Comprehensive Reference Tables｜快速參考表

## VIII.1 句型與必需部分

| 句型 | 例句 | 要問的事 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| S + V | The baby slept. | 需不需要直接受詞? |
| S + V + O | She fixed the light. | 直接受詞是誰/甚麼? |
| S + V + IO + DO | He gave me a note. | 接收者和物件各是甚麼? |
| S + V + DO + to + NP | He gave a note to me. | to 短語是甚麼? |
| S + V + O + C | We painted the wall white. | white 在描述甚麼? |
| S + V + O + place | Put the paper in the bag. | 地點能不能刪去? |
| S + linking V + C | The room seems cold. | 描述的是不是主語? |
| S + V + prep + NP | We listened to her. | 介詞有沒有保留? |
| S + V + to-clause | I hope to win. | 誰會做第二個動作? |
| S + V + O + to-clause | I asked Jo to wait. | 誰要等? |
| S + V + -ing clause | I enjoy dancing. | 後面是哪一類動詞形式? |
| S + V + that-clause | I believe that it works. | 這個內容是誰的想法? |


## VIII.2 動詞配搭查閱表

| 常見類別 | 動詞舉例 | 一般模式與注意點 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 多作不及物 | arrive, happen, die, sneeze | 一般不直接接被「到達/發生」的東西。 |
| 多作一受詞 | enjoy, discuss, contact, resemble | 通常直接接對象,別亂加介詞。 |
| 可有可無受詞 | eat, read, write, sing, drive | 有時可單獨說活動。 |
| 變化/使變化 | open, break, melt, freeze, change | 主語與受詞角色會互換。 |
| 雙受詞 | give, lend, send, show, tell | 接收者 + 物件。 |
| 受詞 + 描述 | make, elect, appoint, keep, find | 最後一項常描述受詞。 |
| 受詞 + 位置 | put, place, lay, set | 地點在部分意思下不可少。 |
| 連繫動詞 | be, become, seem, look, feel, taste | 後面描述主語,通常不算直接受詞。 |
| 介詞動詞 | listen to, look after, depend on | 介詞要與動詞一起看。 |
| to 子句 | want, hope, plan, decide | 看誰做後面的動作。 |
| -ing 子句 | enjoy, avoid, finish, consider | 注意詞彙限制。 |
| 雙人 + to 子句 | ask, tell, persuade, allow | 後面動作的人通常是受詞。 |


## VIII.3 值得分清的三種不同「兩樣東西」

| 英文 | 應怎樣看 |
| --- | --- |
| She gave Kim a card. | 兩個受詞:Kim 和 a card。 |
| They called Kim captain. | 受詞 Kim;captain 說明 Kim 的稱號或角色。 |
| She put the card on the table. | 受詞是 card;on the table 說放在哪裏。 |


# PART IX — Diagnostic Tests & Challenging Examples｜練習題(不附答案)

**做題方法:**先看英文語境,然後找主要動詞,想清楚是否有直接受詞、兩受詞、補充描述或介詞短語。選擇題只選一個最合適的答案。改寫題遵守括號內的指定句型。最後一組是解釋題,需要比較意思;沒有要求只有一種寫法時,可用自然英文或中文說明。

IX.A｜選擇題

Q001

In “Maya locked the gate”, which words are the direct object?

A. Maya

B. the gate

C. locked

【以下句子中,哪一組字是直接受詞?】

Q002

Which sentence uses an intransitive verb without an object?

A. The train arrived early.

B. The guard checked our tickets.

C. The nurse opened the door.

【哪句的動詞沒有直接受詞?】

Q003

Choose the sentence with the normal verb pattern.

A. We discussed about the schedule.

B. We discussed the schedule.

C. We discussed on the schedule.

【選出使用一般標準動詞接法的句子。】

Q004

Choose the most natural sentence about arriving at a station.

A. We reached at the station.

B. We entered at the station.

C. We arrived at the station.

【選出描述到達車站的自然句子。】

Q005

Which words give the location but are not a direct object? “The coach waited near the door.”

A. the coach

B. near the door

C. waited

【在這句中,哪一組字說明地點,卻不是直接受詞?】

Q006

Which sentence correctly uses listen?

A. Please listen to the announcement.

B. Please listen the announcement.

C. Please listen at the announcement.

【哪句的 listen 接法正確?】

Q007

Which sentence says who owns the backpack?

A. The backpack belongs Maya.

B. The backpack belongs with Maya.

C. The backpack belongs to Maya.

【哪句清楚表示背包屬於某人?】

Q008

In “The visitor thanked the guide”, who receives the thanks?

A. the visitor

B. the guide

C. no one

【句中誰受到感謝?】

Q009

Choose the correct sentence using enter in its ordinary sense.

A. They entered to the office.

B. They entered at the office.

C. They entered the office.

【選出 enter 表示進入時的普通正確寫法。】

Q010

Which sentence directly names the person contacted?

A. We contacted the technician.

B. We contacted to the technician.

C. We contacted with the technician.

【哪句直接說明聯絡對象?】

Q011

What changes between “He is reading” and “He is reading a magazine”?

A. The second names what he reads.

B. The first is past tense.

C. The second has no object.

【兩句之間最重要的差別是甚麼?】

Q012

Which sentence means that someone caused the change?

A. The glass broke.

B. The branch fell.

C. Lena broke the glass.

【哪句有說明某人令物件出現變化?】

Q013

Which is an intransitive use of change?

A. They changed the password.

B. The weather changed.

C. He changed the timetable.

【哪句的 change 沒有直接受詞?】

Q014

What is the role of “her sister” in “Kim lent her sister a laptop”?

A. The thing lent

B. The location

C. The receiver

【這句中 her sister 是哪個角色?】

Q015

Which sentence has two objects in the usual teaching analysis?

A. Ella sent Jo a letter.

B. Ella read in silence.

C. Ella arrived before noon.

【哪句有兩個受詞?】

Q016

Which sentence places the recipient in a to-phrase?

A. They showed Emma the photo.

B. They showed the photo to Emma.

C. They showed Emma smiling.

【哪句用 to 短語說明接收者?】

Q017

Which sentence describes making food for someone?

A. They cooked dinner at noon.

B. They cooked a large dinner.

C. They cooked dinner for their uncle.

【哪句表示為某人煮食?】

Q018

Which sentence uses explain correctly in normal standard English?

A. Please explain me the answer.

B. Please explain the answer to me.

C. Please explain for me the answer.

【哪句使用 explain 的一般標準接法?】

Q019

Choose the normal sentence using suggest.

A. She suggested a new route to us.

B. She suggested us a new route.

C. She suggested us to take a new route.

【選出 suggest 的一般標準接法。】

Q020

Which sentence uses donate naturally?

A. They donated the centre new books.

B. They donated with new books to the centre.

C. They donated new books to the centre.

【哪句使用 donate 的接法自然?】

Q021

In “He made Tim nervous”, what is nervous?

A. A second thing given to Tim

B. A description of Tim

C. The subject of the sentence

【在這句中,nervous 做甚麼工作?】

Q022

Which sentence means the door became blue after painting?

A. They painted the blue door.

B. The blue door was old.

C. They painted the door blue.

【哪句表示門油漆後變成藍色?】

Q023

Which is a complex-transitive pattern with a role after the object?

A. They named Imani treasurer.

B. They gave Imani a key.

C. They met Imani at noon.

【哪句用受詞後的職位名稱描述那個人?】

Q024

What does “warm” describe in “Keep the soup warm”?

A. Keep

B. the soup

C. the person speaking

【在這句中,warm 描述甚麼?】

Q025

Which sentence gives a place required by put?

A. Put the files.

B. Put near the door.

C. Put the files on the shelf.

【哪句有完整的 put 放置句型?】

Q026

Which sentence adds optional place information to play?

A. The children played near the river.

B. The children placed a toy on a shelf.

C. The assistant put a label on the box.

【哪句在 play 後加了額外的地點資料?】

Q027

Which sentence is about making something flat?

A. He hammered the flat sheet.

B. He hammered the sheet flat.

C. He hammered beside the sheet.

【哪句表示把東西弄平?】

Q028

In “Lily became a manager”, what is a manager?

A. A direct object

B. A location

C. A description of Lily's new role

【在這句中,a manager 的工作是甚麼?】

Q029

Which sentence uses the linking meaning of look?

A. The classroom looks bright.

B. She looked at the classroom.

C. She looked through the window.

【哪句使用 look 表示看起來怎樣?】

Q030

In “The cake tastes sweet”, sweet describes which part?

A. the person tasting

B. the cake

C. a separate object

【sweet 描述哪一個部分?】

Q031

Choose the correct pattern with remind meaning make someone remember.

A. This smell reminds to me of home.

B. This smell reminds me home.

C. This smell reminds me of home.

【選出表示使人想起某事的自然句子。】

Q032

Which sentence is a separable phrasal verb with a pronoun in the right position?

A. Please turn it off.

B. Please turn off it.

C. Please turn it of.

【哪句的短代字位置正確?】

Q033

Which sentence uses look after with the intended meaning care for?

A. They look their aunt after.

B. They look after their aunt.

C. They look their aunt up after.

【哪句的 look after 表示照顧,寫法也正確?】

Q034

Choose the complete multiword verb meaning tolerate.

A. I cannot put with the heat.

B. I cannot put up the heat.

C. I cannot put up with the heat.

【選出表示忍受的完整動詞片語。】

Q035

Which sentence uses want with a to-infinitive?

A. He wants to leave.

B. He wants leaving.

C. He wants leave.

【哪句用 want 加 to 動詞?】

Q036

Choose the ordinary pattern with avoid.

A. We avoid to swim at night.

B. We avoid swimming at night.

C. We avoid swim at night.

【選出 avoid 的普通正確寫法。】

Q037

Which sentence means Sara will do the waiting?

A. Sara told Ben to wait.

B. Sara asked Ben to wait.

C. Sara decided to wait.

【哪句清楚表示等候的人是 Sara?】

Q038

Which sentence says that Ben is the person invited to wait?

A. Mia asked Ben to wait.

B. Mia promised Ben that she would wait.

C. Mia decided to wait.

【哪句清楚表示 Ben 被要求等候?】

Q039

Choose the usual active pattern with make meaning force.

A. They made us to stay.

B. They made us stay.

C. They made to us stay.

【選出 make 表示迫使時的普通主動句寫法。】

Q040

Which sentence is a normal passive form of “The guard made them wait”?

A. They were made wait.

B. They were made waiting.

C. They were made to wait.

【哪句是原句自然的被動寫法?】

Q041

Which sentence means stopping a reading activity?

A. He stopped reading.

B. He stopped to read.

C. He started reading.

【哪句表示停止閱讀這個活動?】

Q042

Which sentence means pausing another activity in order to read?

A. She stopped reading.

B. She stopped to read.

C. She finished reading.

【哪句表示停下別的活動,然後閱讀?】

Q043

Which sentence shows knowing an indirect question?

A. I know the route.

B. I know that the route is long.

C. I know where the route begins.

【哪句包含間接問題內容?】

Q044

Choose the normal reported-question word order.

A. She asked where the tickets were.

B. She asked where were the tickets.

C. She asked where did the tickets go.

【選出普通間接問句的正確字序。】

Q045

Choose the sentence in which the person receiving information follows tell.

A. She told that the shop had closed.

B. She told us that the shop had closed.

【哪句的 tell 後面有接收消息的人?】

Q046

Which sentence is passive with the receiver as subject?

【哪句被動句把接收者放在主語?】

Q047

Which sentence is a normal passive built from a verb with a direct object?

A. The report was checked carefully.

【哪句是由有直接受詞的動詞形成的自然被動句?】

Q048

Which sentence preserves the preposition in a passive?

A. The baby was looked.

B. The baby was looked after.

C. The baby was looked to after.

【哪句被動句保留原來的介詞?】

Q049

Which word represents the object of buy in “What did you buy?”

A. you

B. did

C. what

【在這句中,buy 要問的受詞是甚麼?】

Q050

Which sentence asks about the subject?

A. Who broke the chair?

B. Who did you call?

C. What did she buy?

【哪句是問誰做了事情?】

Q051

What does the sentence “The storm damaged the roof” tell us?

A. A person chose to damage something.

# PART X — Final Coverage Check｜學完後自己檢查

學完後,不用背全部名稱,也應該可以自己問出以下問題:

我能先找到句子的主要動詞,再找出直接受詞。

我能分清 She smiled 和 She smiled a warm smile,也知道後者是特殊用法。

我能分清單受詞、雙受詞,以及受詞後面的描述。

我知道 give someone something 和 explain something to someone 的排列不同。

我能分清 The door opened、She opened the door 和 The door was opened。

我能找出 put 需要的地點,並知道額外的地點短語有時可刪掉。

我不會把 happy、on the table 或 to him 自動當成第二個受詞。

我能分清 look happy 和 look at someone。

我能正確使用 want to leave、tell someone to leave、let someone leave 和 avoid leaving。

我明白 think that...、know what... 和 ask whether... 後面的子句各有不同結構。

我能分析問句、否定句、被動句和關係子句中的受詞位置。

遇到特殊或地區用法,我會查清楚意思和使用情境,避免把少見寫法一概說成錯。

最後的自問:「這個動詞在這句是甚麼意思?它需要哪些人、物、地點或描述?哪個部分只是多加的消息?」只要能一步一步回答,就可以把這套方法用在新的英文句子。
